name: Executive
summary: C-suite and senior leadership focused on strategic decisions, ROI, and big-picture outcomes. Highly time-constrained.
description: C-suite and senior leaders deciding on strategy, ROI, and big-picture outcomes with very little time. Lead with the conclusion and keep to one insight per slide; set the key numbers in bold type and use as few bullet points as possible. Keep chart density low and the deck to 10-15 slides at most.
